metadata.description: Hydro-Québec stations listing SWE (GMON passive gamma, 6-hourly) or snow depth (hourly). The feed holds only a rolling ~10-day window; the archive accumulates it nightly. CC BY-NC 4.0: attribution required, no commercial use.

properties.name: Romaine 1 Météo (CM6D)
properties.notes: Hydro-Québec open data, CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/): attribution required, no commercial use. The feed keeps only a rolling ~10-day window, so this archive's CSV is the accumulated record from the first nightly refresh on; GMON history before that is in CanSWE (HQ- stations).

data_variables.name: Humidité relative.2 mètres
data_variables.description: Relative humidity at 2 m, hourly instantaneous.
data_variables.notes: Daily = mean over the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Précipitation
data_variables.description: Hourly total precipitation (rain and snow water).
data_variables.notes: Hourly sums; daily = sum over the local day (needs >= 20 valid hours). Negative values are nulled. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Température Maximum
data_variables.description: Hourly maximum air temperature.
data_variables.notes: Daily = max of hourly maxima over the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Température Minimum
data_variables.description: Hourly minimum air temperature.
data_variables.notes: Daily = min of hourly minima over the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Épaisseur de neige
data_variables.description: Depth of snow on the ground, hourly instantaneous.
data_variables.notes: Native cm. Sensor type not stated by Hydro-Québec (the portal says GMON measures both depth and SWE). Negative near-zero noise is nulled. Daily = last valid value of the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Équivalent en eau de la neige
data_variables.description: Snow water equivalent from a GMON passive gamma sensor.
data_variables.notes: Native mm, returned in cm. Published hourly but the GMON value changes only every 6 h (~01/07/13/19 UTC); hours in between repeat the last reading. Daily = last valid value of the America/Toronto local day. Early-season GMON readings can be spurious when the ground is bare. Rolling ~10-day window only. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

The feed keeps only a rolling ~10-day window, so this archive's CSV is the accumulated record from the first nightly refresh on; GMON history before that is in CanSWE (HQ- stations).

data_variables.name: Humidité relative.2 mètres
data_variables.description: Relative humidity at 2 m, hourly instantaneous.
data_variables.notes: Daily = mean over the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Niveau
data_variables.description: Water level (lake, reservoir or river), hourly.
data_variables.notes: Mostly hourly means; two sites report instantaneous level (``Instantanée``). Daily = mean over the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Précipitation
data_variables.description: Hourly total precipitation (rain and snow water).
data_variables.notes: Hourly sums; daily = sum over the local day (needs >= 20 valid hours). Negative values are nulled. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Température Maximum
data_variables.description: Hourly maximum air temperature.
data_variables.notes: Daily = max of hourly maxima over the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Température Minimum
data_variables.description: Hourly minimum air temperature.
data_variables.notes: Daily = min of hourly minima over the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.

data_variables.name: Épaisseur de neige
data_variables.description: Depth of snow on the ground, hourly instantaneous.
data_variables.notes: Native cm. Sensor type not stated by Hydro-Québec (the portal says GMON measures both depth and SWE). Negative near-zero noise is nulled. Daily = last valid value of the local day. Dates and n_obs cover the rolling window only.
